hero.headline:
Precision Crafted.
Personally Yours.
hero.subhead: Custom leather & acrylic gifts and décor — laser cut, hand-finished, made to order. Wholesale & retail.

founder.name: Owner
founder.body:
Lumi Liv started with a simple idea — that gifts should feel personal, not generic. Every piece that leaves our workshop is cut, engraved, and finished by hand, made exactly the way you imagined it.

Thank you for letting us be part of your celebrations.

services.heading: Our Services.
services.intro: One thread runs through everything we make. Bring us your idea — in leather, acrylic, or anything in between — and we'll cut, engrave, and stitch it into shape.

items.title: Laser Cutting
items.body: Precise custom cuts in leather, acrylic, wood, and more — however intricate the design.

items.title: Engraving
items.body: Fine detail engraved into metal, acrylic, and leather alike.

items.title: Stitching
items.body: Hand-stitched seams and finishes, built to last — not just look good.

items.title: Custom Design
items.body: Send a sketch, a photo, or just an idea — we'll turn it into a finished piece, made to order.

gallery.heading: A few things we've made — in leather, acrylic, and everything in between.

banner.text: Got something in mind? If you can sketch it, we can cut it.

lifestyle.text: Follow along for behind-the-scenes and finished pieces. From color picks to custom requests, your ideas help shape what we make next.

contact.headline: Got an idea?
contact.body: Tell us what you're picturing — we'll help make it real.
